project.name: oaiscore
project.description:
OAIS core library - the StructureRepInfo / SemanticRepInfo / RepresentationInformation model interfaces and reference implementations this project's adapters bridge concrete binary-parsing engines onto. Vendored in as its own reactor module (copied from the separate dgiaretta/OAISIFBBCandidiate repository's oaisCore project, https://github.com/dgiaretta/OAISIFBBCandidiate/tree/master/oaisCore) so the whole project - including the aggregated Javadoc - builds in one `mvn install` from the root, without a separate clone-and-install step.
Its original pom.xml depended on the full spring-boot-starter-parent BOM (Spring Boot, Spring Web, Jackson XML, JAXB), but grepping every import in its actual source shows only two real external dependencies: Jackson's ObjectMapper/Module classes (json/, serialization/ and the Json2Java utility) and, in one class (config/JacksonConfig), Spring's plain @Configuration/@Bean annotations - so this pom declares just those, at the versions Spring Boot 3.0.1's BOM pinned them to, rather than pulling in Spring Boot itself. implementation/utility/OaisIfConfig.txt is carried over unchanged, including its .txt extension: it is real Java source for a Spring Web/Spring Boot autoconfiguration class, kept out of the build the same way it already was (Maven only compiles .java files under src/main/java) rather than newly excluded here.
